g.text: Width and height are the overall door sizes in the model, not the clear opening width used for egress checks.
"From / to" lists the rooms the model records on each side of the door; one room means an exterior door or a missing boundary.
Fire ratings are blank in the source model.
BSI (2020) "Medical-Dental Test Files," buildingSMART International. License: CC BY 4.0.
Changes: drawings generated from the 3D model (clinic.ifc); the model itself is unchanged.
Generated automatically from the IFC model for review demos. Not a construction document. Check the scale bar before measuring from a print.
